hederaTestnet.note: Requests settle in HTS USDC (0.0.429274, 6 dp); SETTLEMENT_ASSET=hbar switches back to native HBAR. Staking/slash is always native-HBAR escrow via the Hedera SDK. Reputation is a separate HTS ReputationBond token (bondToken, set by `pnpm setup-hts`) with a custom fractional fee + freeze/pause/wipe compliance controls; on fraud the verifier destroys it with a 2-of-2 multi-sig TokenWipe (verifier + auditor). Agent identity is HCS-14-style (uaid:aid:hedera:testnet:0.0.x) published to the registry topic via the Hedera Agent Kit. No Solidity anywhere — HCS + HTS + Mirror Node, all SDK-native.

zerogChain.note: 0G Chain (Galileo, chain 16602) is the EVM-native provenance/identity leg — distinct from the Hedera settlement leg above. verdictRegistry (VerdictRegistry.sol) records each 0G-served trade's verifier verdict on-chain; agentNft (AgentNFT.sol, ERC-7857-style) mints the buyer agent as a tradeable Agentic ID whose intelligent-data is the 0G Storage root of its encrypted memory. Both live in packages/onchain-0g and are deployed with `forge script script/Deploy.s.sol` — paste the printed addresses into verdictRegistry/agentNft here and into .env (ZEROG_VERDICT_REGISTRY, ZEROG_AGENT_NFT). Inference runs on 0G Compute (computeRouter, OpenAI-compatible; TEE-verified with X-0G-Provider-Trust-Mode: verified). erc8004IdentityRegistry is 0G's live ERC-8004 registry, an optional discoverability path. Unlike the Hedera leg, this leg uses Solidity (0G Chain is EVM).
